query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_events, 
  COUNT(CASE WHEN category = 'economic' THEN 1 END) as economic_events,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN category = 'war' THEN 1 END) as war_events,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN category = 'policy' THEN 1 END) as policy_events,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN category = 'humanitarian' THEN 1 END) as humanitarian_events,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN severity = 'critical' THEN 1 END) as critical_events
FROM events;
